title: Link hosts
description: The contents of link-hosts.yml: the hosts a line added by a proposed documentation change may link to, and how long a new link's query string may be.

max_query_length.description: The longest query string (the text after ?) a new link may carry, unless its host is in long_query_hosts.

long_query_hosts.description: Exact host names whose new links may carry a query string of any length.

hosts.description: A host name, a host name under *. (any host below it, not the name itself), or a host name and a path (github.com/notes-co: that path and everything under it, case ignored). Lower case, no scheme, port or trailing dot; a wildcard names at least two labels.
